title: Pasta Pizza Bake
subtitle: with cottage cheese and olives
description: Short pasta is mixed with a creamy cottage cheese and olive custard, layered with tomato passata and topped with melted cheese. Baked until golden.

steps.text: Cook the pasta for half the time stated on the packet. Drain.
In a bowl, mix the cream, cottage cheese, halved olives, salt, pepper and eggs.
Combine the pasta with the creamy mixture and mix well.

Grease a baking dish with a little olive oil. Spread half the pasta mixture evenly in the dish and pour a thin layer of passata over it. Spread the remaining pasta mixture on top and pour over the rest of the passata.
Sprinkle with the grated cheese, cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes. Remove the foil and bake for another 15 minutes, until golden.
